A '''contact stunner''' was a small personal protection device. It had a dozen contact disks on one end that ensured it would deliver a concentrated jolt of energy. It operated on a single [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cell]]. It was easy to conceal due to its slender and compact design.<ref name="UR" />
